envelope.description: Build the deadline-bound refresh and route tracker.sync through it

body.title: Build the deadline-bound refresh and route tracker.sync through it
body.summary: Add refreshTrackerStatus(repoPath, { epicHash?, deadline? }) with TRACKER_REFRESH_DEADLINE_MS (120 s) and rebuild syncTracker over the port, keeping the SyncResult shape (synced, skipped, failed) unchanged so the terminal client and existing sync tests keep working: the Deadline is checked before every read, its signal is passed to the registry calls through workflowToolDeps so a call in flight is cancelled, an adapter without status-read is a failed result naming the capability, a ToolDenied is rethrown, other failures and the deadline are skipped or failed results with one warning line each. The tracker.sync daemon method returns the SyncResult of the one Epic through the same function (repoPath stays required and names an absolute registered repo).
acceptanceChecks: success writes epicStatus, storyStatus and lastSyncedAt into meta.tracker and nothing else
the SyncResult shape (synced, skipped, failed) is unchanged and the existing sync tests pass as they are
a slow tracker hits the budget and the unread Epics and Stories are reported skipped with 'time limit reached'
a gh call in flight is cancelled when the Deadline signal aborts
a non-GitHub port gets the same steps and a port without status-read fails naming it

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/refresh.test.ts: refreshTrackerStatus writes epicStatus, storyStatus and lastSyncedAt only
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/refresh.test.ts: a port without status-read fails naming the capability and a read that fails is a failed result
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/refresh.test.ts: a slow port hits the budget with an injected Deadline and the unread Epics and Stories are skipped with time limit reached
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/refresh.test.ts: a ToolDenied is rethrown and a non-GitHub fake port gets the same fields
src/daemon/__tests__/tracker-sync-method.test.ts: tracker.sync runs refreshTrackerStatus for the one Epic and returns its SyncResult
